credit: Eduardo Meneses, Learn shader art. Palette after Inigo Quilez.
description: The course in one shader: a signed distance field, a cosine palette, an antialiased edge, and every number exposed as a named parameter.
The four smallest useful fragment shaders, one after another: a flat colour, the coordinate as colour, a single channel, and the coordinate moved by time.
The same circle drawn in three coordinate spaces, so the aspect-ratio mistake and its two fixes are visible side by side.
